title: Cap. V Obj. 6 Sol: Christ Head has causal priority — even the destined grafting comes from him
pass_a_gloss: For Christ the Head of the Church is so joined with all his members, that he himself obtains the priority of Causality with respect to all the rest, and that through and on account of him every outflow of free good is derived to others: but it is derived not only after they have been grafted into Christ by faith, but so that this very benefit, that they are destinated to be grafted into him by faith, is to be fetched from him, and conferred on us in him. What therefore they say, that Christ has been predestinated Savior of the faithful only, that indeed is true, because he leads all the predestinated through to salvation only by faith; but not because faith is found in all the predestinated before the very decree of election.
pass_b_english: Christ the Church's Head is so joined to all his members that he holds causal priority over all the rest, and every outflow of free good to others comes through and for him — not only after they are grafted into Christ by faith, but so that even the benefit of being destinated to be grafted by faith is fetched from him and conferred on us in him. That Christ was predestinated Savior of the faithful only is true — he leads all the predestinated to salvation only by faith — not because faith is found in all the predestinated before the election decree itself.
source_text: Nam Caput Ecclesiae Christus ita conjunctus est cum membris suis omnibus, ut ipse prioritatem Causalitatis respectu reliquorum omnium obtineat, atque ut per et propter ipsum omnis boni gratuiti effluxus ad alios derivetur: derivatur autem non solummodo postquam sunt Christo insiti per fidem, sed ita ut hoc ipsum beneficium, quod per fidem illi inserendi destinantur, ab eo arcessendum sit, et in eo nobis conferendum. Quod igitur dicunt, Christum praedestinatum esse Salvatorem fidelium solummodo, id quidem verum est, quia non nisi per fidem omnes praedestinatos ad salutem perducit; non autem quia fides in omnibus praedestinatis ante ipsum decretum electionis invenitur.
